summary_rationale: AXISCADES possesses genuine defence electronics and embedded IP via Mistral Solutions (Ashwini LLTR SDPU, Virupaksha AESA radar, Kusha LRBMR, Man-Portable Counter-Drone Systems), durable Airbus/Boeing aerospace pedigree, and a decisive ~Rs 2,256 Cr Akkodis divestment that exits low-margin Heavy Engineering, Automotive, Energy, and Aerospace staffing to focus on Defence, Aero Manufacturing/MRO, ESAI, and Space (+55% YoY retained revenue growth in H1 FY27). However, it fails an unconditional compounder classification on cash conversion and balance-sheet forensics: FY26 CFO collapsed to -Rs 1 Cr (FCF -Rs 135 Cr) as Debtor Days climbed to 130 days (Rs 411 Cr receivables), gross borrowings surged 2.7x from Rs 258 Cr (Mar 2025) to Rs 698 Cr (Sep 2026) alongside CWIP expansion and potential interest capitalization, 3-year ROE averaged just 10.8% with 0% historical dividend payout, and H1 FY27 carried Ind AS 105 restructuring noise, CEO turnover, an Rs 11.56 Cr aged defence receivable provision, and a -13.21% promoter stake reduction to 44.82%.
